stumbles.why: This conflicts with the test "four 503s, then failure". Four retries means five attempts, so four 503s would not yet exhaust the retries. It is unclear whether 4 counts retries or total attempts.

stumbles.quote: The retry count had been 0 since a refactor on 2026-09-14, so nothing retried the request.
stumbles.why: The text never says what the "retry count" is, such as a config value or a constant. It also doesn't say what the refactor was, or whether this change restores a setting or adds new logic. I can't tell how the 0 relates to the new "up to 4 times".

point: The PR makes the Turso client's execute() retry 503 and 429 responses with exponential backoff, so cold-start 503s no longer cause boot to fail with a misleading "auth failed". Cold-boot runs and six new tests back it up.
